conviction_note: The findings roughly cancel. On one side: a likely revenue beat from Blade's Q3 seasonal peak against a consensus set below Q2, and a crowded, rising short (21% of float, 6 days to cover). On the other: Dubai and US first-passenger milestones that look at risk with no confirming announcement, and a put skew of +7.4. impact_sum +0.4 and the scaled +0.38 (p_up 52 x abs 9.5) agree in sign and size. The reaction will turn on the certification and Dubai language, not on revenue, so p_up stays near 50.

Revenue consensus $37.2M (Investing.com), $38.2M (Benzinga), $40.0M (Chartmill); I sized against roughly $38.5M. The stock trades on certification and Dubai timing, which have no numeric bar.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue likely beats consensus because of Blade's seasonality. The CFO said on the Q2 call that 'Blade typically peak[s] in the third quarter'. Blade alone booked $36.2M in Q2 2026, and in 2024 Blade passenger revenue rose 31% from Q2 to Q3 ($29.6M to $38.8M). Consensus of $37.2-40.0M sits at or below Q2's $38.6M total. A Q3 of about $44-50M (+15-30% vs the bar) would also make the H2 guide ($52-62M) look low and imply a FY raise above $115-125M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue beat consensus by 34.5% ($38.64M vs $29.07M) with a FY raise; the stock closed the regular session -2.2% and moved +5.51% over the scored window. Revenue beats are bought mildly; the 21.2% move in May 2026 was not a revenue event.
findings.why_not_priced: If the street had modelled the seasonal peak, Q3 consensus would sit above Q2's $38.6M, not at $37.2-40.0M. Analysts missed Q2 revenue by 34.5% the same way. The 'up 65% YoY' framing of consensus is anchored on the partial-Blade Q3 2025 ($22.6M), not on Blade's own seasonal base.
findings.independence: Blade's 2024 segment seasonality comes from a different source (Fintool table, https://fintool.com/app/research/companies/BLDE/earnings/Q3 2024), and the Q2 2026 revenue miss by consensus is in Benzinga's estimate history. One caveat applies: Q4 2025 Blade was about $21M, so Q4 is seasonally low, which is why the guide looks conservative rather than wrong.

findings.finding: Dubai first passenger service, promised 'before the end of 2026', is at risk of slipping. Dubai was struck by Iranian missiles and drones in early 2026 and DXB passenger traffic fell about 30% in H1. Asked on the Q2 call whether Dubai passengers were still expected this year 'because of the conflict', the CEO gave no date ('we have an aircraft over there, and we can't wait to get going'). Joby has issued no Dubai press release since. The Q3 release has to restate or move the date with under two months left.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior on a Dubai date change. Commercial-timeline news has driven the largest moves (+21.2% in May 2026). Positive operational PRs in 2026 (the autonomous cross-country flight, Resonant Sciences, Florida eIPP) were sold or ignored.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The 2026-11-04 preview still carries 'first passenger operations in Dubai before the end of 2026' as the plan, so a formal slip to 2027 is not in the wire copy. The put skew (+7.4) and the -34% since the last print are consistent with the market leaning this way already, so the residual is small.
findings.independence: Conflict and DXB traffic: https://cryptobriefing.com/dubai-airport-sees-30-drop-in-traffic-amid-iran-conflict/ (proxy, not a company statement). The Joby IR release list (https://ir.jobyaviation.com/news-events/press-releases) shows no Dubai release between Aug and Nov 2026. The RTA's year-end statement (https://english.aaj.tv/news/330451004) is dated 2026-01-16, before the conflict.

findings.finding: As of 2026-11-04 Joby has not announced that FAA pilots have begun 'for-credit' TIA flight testing, which it guided for 'later this year' in its March 2026 release. Nor has it announced first passengers on eIPP flights (Texas launched 2026-09-10; the Florida flights from 2026-10-30 are described as 'piloted' only), although the target is 'first passengers this year'. The release will either confirm these milestones or move them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Certification-milestone headlines have not lifted the stock in 2026: the Aug 20 'new FAA milestone' was followed by a 4% fall. A slip has not been tested in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: The street still frames 2026 first passengers and FAA TIA testing as on track (the Investing.com preview says 'stage four... begun flying its first production-conforming aircraft'). An absence of announcements is weak evidence, because companies often hold milestones for the print, which is why this finding is small and two-sided.
findings.independence: Florida release, 2026-10-30, piloted flights only with no passengers or FAA pilots mentioned: https://ir.jobyaviation.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/195/joby-brings-its-vertical-takeoff-and-landing-air-taxi-to. This shares the IR release list with the Dubai finding, but the fact is different.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-02 a federal jury in Tampa awarded Aerosonic $116.9M against Joby ($68.6M NDA breach, $29.9M trade secrets, $18.3M exemplary). The verdict came after quarter-end but concerns a pre-existing condition, so Q3 GAAP may carry an accrual or loss-contingency disclosure. An accrual would be about $0.12 a share on 989M shares, making a headline GAAP loss of about -$0.37 vs the -$0.25 bar. Joby is moving to overturn it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell about 2% on the verdict. The Q2 2026 EPS miss of 8.7% did not stop a +5.5% move, so the name does not trade on EPS.
findings.why_not_priced: The verdict is priced. An accrual landing in headline GAAP EPS is not in the consensus, because estimates do not model litigation, so a mechanical 'EPS miss' headline is possible. It is cash-immaterial against about $2.1B of liquidity and has no path to the guide.

findings.finding: Joby put out an 8:00 ET press release on the print day expanding its US Air Force autonomy contracts to nearly $37M (operational-testing ceiling raised to $50M), and the stock is up about 6.8% on the day into the print. That lifts the bar the release has to clear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline line. The defense business is small next to Blade and certification.
findings.why_not_priced: The contract is priced by construction: the market had it all session. What is left is a same-day run-up that a neutral release could give back.

findings.finding: Short interest is crowded and building into the print: 143.19M shares, 21.38% of float, 5.99 days to cover, up from 124.30M the prior period. Open interest is call-heavy (put/call 0.27). Any confirmation of the 2026 Dubai or US-passenger dates, or a guide raise, meets shorts who added after the Barclays downgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 6 of the last 8 prints moved up; the largest was +21.2% (May 2026). Down moves were -4.5% and -8.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the market's own bet, not information it lacks. It shows up as the put skew of +7.4, which prices the downside, while the squeeze path is asymmetric to a 21%-of-float short.
findings.independence: The equibles reading (Aug 2026, 10.9% of float on a different base) is older and lower: https://equibles.com/stocks/JOBY

findings.finding: Toyota's $250M direct equity investment in Joby Inc. was guided on the Q2 call to close 'later this year or early next', and closing or a firmer date could be announced with Q3. Q3 cash use of about $200M (H2 guide $385-415M) against $2.3B at June 30 leaves about $2.1B, so no financing is needed in the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2025 Toyota investment news helped push the stock above $10. No later Toyota-tranche event appears in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is small and its timing is uncertain. What the money buys is the manufacturing JV and the production ramp (12 aircraft in the queue), so it is positive or zero, not distress.
findings.independence: Trefis, 2026-10-25, repeats the late-2026 or early-2027 close: https://www.trefis.com/stock/joby/articles2/620485/whats-going-to-happen-with-joby-aviation-stock-soon/2026-10-25. This shares the transcript source with the revenue finding, but the fact is different.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-09 Barclays initiated or downgraded Joby to Underweight with a $4 target, on manufacturing capacity, and the eVTOL group sold off 27-32% in a month (Archer -32%, EHang -29% after it withdrew guidance following an accident). The Q3 release's production update (target: at least 2 aircraft off the line in H2 2026) lands on the Barclays thesis.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Joby fell about 9% intraday on the downgrade. The baseline has no production-line history.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the month's -27% is the reaction. Anything left depends on whether the production update confirms or relieves the capacity concern.

outside_window.finding: Resonant Sciences acquisition closing expected early 2027.
Dubai commercial launch itself (as opposed to the restated date in the release) and FAA type certification; both resolve after the window.

rejected_candidates.detail: The article is dated 2025-02-18, not 2026. It is stale and was superseded by the Jan 2026 RTA statement of a year-end 2026 launch, so it is not evidence of a current slip.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Jan 2026 common-stock and $600M 0.75% convertible offering (conversion price $14.19)
rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the $2.3B June 30 cash figure used in the Toyota/cash finding. It is not a new event in the window.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Insider 10b5-1 sales Aug-Oct 2026 (Bevirt $32.7M across 7 filings through 2026-09-17; Bowles 2026-10-05)
rejected_candidates.detail: The Form 4 footnotes state pre-set 10b5-1 plans (adopted 2026-05-19), so these sales carry no information about the print. This is a judgement call, listed so the panel can disagree.

baseline_tension: The findings mostly agree with the put skew and the -34% since the last print on the milestone risks (Dubai, FAA), and cut against it on revenue and the crowded short. Net, the set sits near zero, which is what a +7.4 skew against a 21%-of-float short looks like.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the revenue-beat finding went from +1.0 to +0.8. The stock trades on certification and Dubai; Q2's 34.5% beat bought only +5.5%.

Lessons 7 and 5 (a crowded short against a negative; a proxy): the Dubai finding went from -1.5 to -0.8, because the conflict link is a proxy rather than a company statement and the short is 21% of float.
Lesson 5 (absence is not a cause): the FAA/US-passenger absence finding went from -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 2 (one-offs as one-offs): the Aerosonic accrual went from -0.3 to -0.2, as it has no path to the guide.
Positioning: the same-day run-up finding went from -0.3 to -0.2.
The crowded-short (+1.0), Toyota (+0.3) and Barclays/sector (-0.2) findings were left unchanged.
p_up went from 50 to 52, because lesson 7 says the crowded short is a mechanism of its own and 6 of 8 prints moved up; the put skew keeps it near 50.
